description: This is a shell script source file defining functions and logic for configuring and managing a network connection via a NCM (Network Connection Management) protocol, including initialization, setup, and teardown routines.

methods.name: proto_ncm_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration parameters for the NCM protocol, setting default values for device, APN, auth, profile, MTU, and other network parameters.

methods.name: proto_ncm_setup
methods.description: Sets up the network interface based on JSON input variables, configures modem settings, initializes network routes for IPv4 and IPv6, and applies MTU settings.

methods.name: proto_ncm_teardown
methods.description: Teardown routine that disconnects the network interface, retrieves modem info, and cleans up network configuration.
